summary: The 'MaintActivityCodes' document provides a web interface for managing Activity Codes within a system. It includes functionality for adding, editing, deleting, and reactivating activity codes through a grid view interface and a detailed popup panel.
purpose: To facilitate the maintenance and management of Activity Codes in a web-based system, allowing authorized users to perform CRUD operations on these codes.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The full name of the activity code.

fields.name: ShortName
fields.description: A shorter version of the activity code name.

capabilities: Add, edit, delete, and reactivate activity codes
Access the interface based on departmental permissions
Add, edit, delete activity codes within assigned departments

workflows.name: Activity Code Management
steps: User selects the agency, department, and program from dropdowns.
User views the list of activity codes in the grid view.
User can add a new code using the 'Add' button.
User can edit or delete existing codes using respective buttons.
Changes are submitted and the view is refreshed.

business_rules: Agency and department must be selected for the screen to be editable.
Only users with appropriate permissions can perform modifications.
validations: Name and ShortName fields are required.
conditions: Screen becomes editable based on agency and department selection and user role.
system_behavior: The grid view updates upon actions like adding, editing or deleting codes.
Popup extends to show details of an activity code for editing.
exceptions: If no agency or department is selected, the screen remains uneditable.
